name: Garnier Hair food Shampoo Papaya
description:
Deep Repair & Nourishment for Dry, Damaged Hair

Give your hair the care it deserves with Garnier Ultimate Blends Hair Food Papaya Shampoo. Formulated with papaya extract, this deeply repairing and hydrating shampoo works on dry, brittle, and damaged hair. It gently cleanses while restoring softness, shine, and vitality from root to tip — a daily hair rescue in one bottle.
